draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
revised_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise in its training annotations: at 10%, 20% and 30% noise its mean test F1 drops by 0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points respectively, all within the pre-specified 2.0-point robustness criterion on the Corvane-News NER test set.
rationale: T2 shows Thornbill-NER drops of 0.6, 1.3, 1.8 points at 10/20/30% noise, all within the pre-specified 2.0-point robustness criterion. The hedged "appears somewhat" understates this complete, criterion-based evaluation; the evidence supports an unqualified robustness claim within the tested scope.
